source: Simulations from set.seed(20261102) to set.seed(20261106), fitted on 61 rectangular nodes with mirt's survey.weights rescaled to the persons, base R's weighted likelihood, TAM's pweights, and mirt on persons repeated by integer weights. The weights are raw; measurekit rescales them.

twoPl.description: 1000 persons, 12 2PL items, 5% missing, log-normal weights: mirt's Richardson and crossprod errors

graded.description: 800 persons, 8 graded items of 4 categories, log-normal weights

groups.description: 1000 persons in two groups, 10 2PL items, 5% missing, weights heavier in the focal group: base R's maximum of the weighted likelihood from mirt's multipleGroup with survey.weights

rasch.description: 1000 persons, 12 Rasch items, theta = 0.6 x + e, log-normal weights: TAM's tam.mml(Y, pweights)

regression.description: 600 persons, 10 2PL items, theta = 0.6 x + e, 5% missing, integer weights 1 to 4: mirt on the persons repeated by their weights; base R's weighted log-likelihood at mirt's estimates with survey.weights, which leave the weights out of the regression
